title: Repair Linux CUDA reference and repeatability correctness
requires: Physical ThomasLaptop RTX 3050 Ti CUDA target
scope: Repair the F8-86 Linux CUDA exit blocker: all 30 public cases retain 5,928 frozen-reference differences with numerical or invariant failures, and cloth-water fails fresh plain-run repeatability. Preserve shared Slang equations, fixed work and immutable candidate-v10 evidence; do not infer correctness from the passing analytic or timing suites alone.
acceptance: Reproduce all 30 public-reference failures and the cloth-water plain-to-plain failure with exact installed source, driver, SDK, GPU and manifest identities.

Identify the first nondeterministic or cross-reference divergence using retained state, dispatch and synchronization evidence. Fix races, initialization, ownership or shared-equation defects without relaxing tolerances or excluding samples.
Pass all 30 public cases in plain and validation modes, repeated-run comparisons, 49 capability obligations, 12 physical scenarios, five negative controls and lifecycle/recovery assertions.

Preserve one fixed advance, one shared spatial publication and independent iteration, dispatch, submission, readback and synchronization ceilings. Retain the full workload timing protocol and all stalls.
Pass installed SDK relocation and Gallery checks and publish complete before/after evidence.
